notes: Nesting is fixed. The net list was drawn in array order with the parent used only as an indent, so a re-homed net landed wherever it happened to sit in the list and a net whose parent was gone could vanish entirely. Order now follows actual parentage: children always render under their parent, nests can go deeper than one level, orphans surface at top level instead of disappearing, collapsing a nest folds only that nest, and every edit is confirmed against the relay. Also: bigger, more legible type throughout, Atkinson Hyperlegible as the default typeface, and a text size control (Ctrl + / Ctrl -).
